item.title: SUP Yoga on the Petaluma River — Fri Oct 23, 5:30 PM — The Floathouse Petaluma
item.description: This is SUP Yoga the Petaluma way—right downtown, deeply local, and rooted in our river. SUP Yoga at The Floathouse Petaluma invites locals to slow down and experience the Petaluma River as part of everyday life. Though we launch from the heart of downtown, the central turning basin holds a special calm. Once you’re on the water, the noise drops away and the river becomes what many of us love most about Petaluma: peaceful, welcoming, and shared. Sessions are gentle and all-levels, designed for neighbors as much as newcomers. We begin with a short, easy paddle from the docks to get comfortable on your board (knees are always welcome), then anchor together so tidal movement won’t interrupt your flow. From there, you’re free to move, stretch, breathe, rest—or simply float—guided by expert instruction and supported by community. item.title: Napa County Historical Society Announces the 2026 Heritage Halloween Tulocay Cemetery Tour — Sat Oct 24, 12:00 AM — Tulocay Cemetary
item.description: Heritage Halloween Tulocay Cemetery Tour Step into Napa’s past during the 2026 Heritage Halloween Tulocay Cemetery Tour, presented by the Napa County Historical Society and sponsored by Napa County Landmarks. Founded in 1857 on the Juarez Tulucay Rancho, Tulocay Cemetery is among the oldest public cemeteries in California and has served the Napa community for generations. This special 90-minute walking tour explores some of the cemetery’s oldest sections while sharing the stories of historic figures who helped shape Napa Valley. Beginning at the Juarez Building just inside Tulocay’s original gates, the tour is led by a knowledgeable Tulocay Cemetery intern. Complimentary maps and whisper headsets are provided to help guests follow along throughout the experience. The cemetery’s paved paths include steep and hilly areas, so comfortable walking shoes are recommended. Guests using scooters, walkers, or other mobility aids should ensure their equipment is suitable for inclines. Date: Satur

item.description:
Ghosts of Petaluma’s Past Come to Life on Our Annual Cemetery Tour!
27th ANNUAL CEMETERY WALK PRESENTED BY THE PETALUMANS OF YESTERYEAR
Saturday, October 24, 2026 – Starting times: 10:30 a.m. and 11:00 am
Ticket Cost: $20
Cypress Hill Cemetery
430 Magnolia Ave, Petaluma CA
Go to EventBrite for Tickets
Join the Petalumans of Yesteryear for a guided graveside tour featuring some of the most notable and interesting residents of early Petaluma.
You’ll hear colorful stories about life \(and death\) in our town’s early days, directly from our costumed living history docents representing the likes of Lyman Byce, Addie Atwater, Ida Belle McNear, and many others.
The tour begins at the Cypress Hill Memorial Park office parking lot and concludes inside the Cypress Hill columbarium, which was designed by noted Petaluma architect Brainerd Jones. item.title: KSRO Presents Jimmy Failla — Sat Oct 24, 8:00 PM — Luther Burbank Center for the Arts
item.description:
Jimmy Failla’s Escape from New York Tour, coming to the LBC on October 24, is the comedian’s return to his natural habitat of live standup comedy. Long before Fox News gave him a TV show and what he calls “some much-needed makeup,” Jimmy was performing in clubs and colleges across the country nearly every week of the year. Now he's back on the road with an hour of new material that puts everyone in the splash zone - politicians, celebrities, and pretty much anybody else who needs a comedy beatdown in what Failla refers to as “this funhouse we call America.” It's a night of uncensored standup along with an audience Q&A that leaves nothing off limits, including, he claims, his famous Fox News friends.
Source: North Bay Bohemian, Press Democrat
